theme_and_archetype.reasoning: For an ERP, Admin Panel, and POS, data clarity and functional authority are paramount. Swiss & High-Contrast provides a clean, highly structured base. We inject the requested brand colors (Blue, Green, Purple) to create a 'Modern Tech' feeling without muddying data visibility.

brand.name: Integra SYS
brand.visual_identity: Modern, clean, technological, responsive, and professional

application_mapping.admin_master: Use Purple (#8B5CF6) as the primary interaction color to denote Master/God-level access and premium control.
application_mapping.web_saas: Use Blue (#2563EB) as the primary interaction color for daily business tasks, representing trust and corporate stability.
application_mapping.mobile_pos: Use Green (#10B981) for primary actions (Sales, Payments, Checkout) to denote success and fast monetary flow. Use Red for cancellations.

layout_and_spacing.general: Generous spacing (p-6, p-8) for Web/Admin containers. Structural grids with 1px borders.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Subtle rounded corners (rounded-lg, max 8px) to maintain a crisp, technological feel. Do not use fully rounded pill shapes except for status badges.
layout_and_spacing.shadows: Avoid heavy drop shadows. Use 1px borders (border-slate-200) for definition. Use soft shadow-sm only on hover states or floating command palettes.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Control Room Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Cards must use h-full to stretch equally.

components.buttons: Flat backgrounds with sharp text contrast. Must include data-testid. Hover state should darken background slightly.
components.inputs: Shadcn Input, Select, and Command. 1px solid border, ring-2 on focus with brand color.
components.tables: Data-dense, row borders only (no vertical lines). Use sticky headers and right-align numerical data (financials, stock).
components.navigation: Sidebar for Web SaaS and Admin Master. Bottom sheet or large tab bar for Mobile POS. Always include Command Palette (Cmd+K) for quick search.
components.cards: Cardless aesthetic or flat white surfaces with 1px border. No drop shadow by default.

1_admin_master.focus: High-level management of the multi-tenant environment.
1_admin_master.vibe: Command center. High data density. Accent color: Purple.

2_web_saas.focus: Daily business operations for the client.
2_web_saas.vibe: Clean, trustworthy, organized. Calm design to reduce cognitive overload. Accent color: Blue.

3_mobile_pos.vibe: Touch-optimized. Large tap targets. Clear color coding (Green = Pay, Red = Cancel). Left side for product grid, Right side for active cart. Accent color: Green.

interactions_and_motion.hover: All clickable items must have a clear hover state (bg color shift or text color shift).
interactions_and_motion.loading: Use skeleton loaders matching the bento grid shape instead of spinners.

image_urls.description: Abstract 3D blocks. Use for Admin or SaaS login screen background with a glassmorphism overlay.
Modern POS setup. Use as a placeholder image for onboarding or empty states in the POS app.
Business team. Use for the Users/Permissions section empty state or Support module.

icons: Use lucide-react (default) for fast setup and clean tech look, or @phosphor-icons/react if extreme density is required.
testing: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, tabs) MUST have a kebab-case data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='admin-login-button', data-testid='pos-checkout').
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Import Outfit and IBM Plex Sans from Google Fonts. 2. Build the 3 sub-apps using distinct primary interaction colors (Admin=Purple, SaaS=Blue, POS=Green). 3. Use Shadcn UI but flatten the aesthetics (1px borders, minimal shadow, h-full cards). 4. Build a responsive sidebar for Web/Admin, and a side-by-side tablet view for Mobile POS. 5. Integrate the Integra Code logo where brand presence is required. 6. DO NOT FORGET data-testid ON ALL INTERACTIVE ELEMENTS.
